elements.label: Table 4.1
elements.title: Population Parameters and Point Estimates for Mean and Proportion
elements.details:
| Population Parameter | Point Estimate |
|----------------------|----------------|
| **Mean**             | Population mean is denoted as μ. | Point estimate is the sample mean x̄. |
| **Proportion**       | Population proportion is denoted as p. | Point estimate is the sample proportion p̂. |
elements.summary: This table summarizes the notation and definitions for population parameters (mean and proportion) and their corresponding point estimates from sample data.
